sloka: जल प्रपात अस्र मुखाः शृन्गैः उच्छ्रित बाहवः ।सीतायाम् ह्रियमाणायाम् विक्रोशन्ति इव पर्वताः ॥३-५२-३७॥
transliteration: jala prapāta asra mukhāḥ śṛngaiḥ ucchrita bāhavaḥ ।sītāyām hriyamāṇāyām vikrośanti iva parvatāḥ ॥3-52-37॥

translations.english: The mountains were shedding tears in the form of waterfalls, and crying with hands lifted up in the form of peaks, while Sita was being carried away.
